description: AlphaFold per-residue confidence across KRT9 domains
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P35527", timeout=120)
print("API status:", r.status_code)
js=r.json(); e=js[0]
print({k:e[k] for k in e if k in ("entryId","latestVersion","uniprotStart","uniprotEnd","modelCreatedDate")})
pdb=requests.get(e["pdbUrl"], timeout=180).text
print("pdb bytes:", len(pdb), "| first line:", pdb.splitlines()[0][:70])

plddt={}
for ln in pdb.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        plddt[int(ln[22:26])]=float(ln[60:66])
res=np.array(sorted(plddt)); v=np.array([plddt[x] for x in res])
print("CA residues:", len(res))

regions=[("head",1,152),("coil 1A",153,188),("L1",189,207),("coil 1B",208,299),
         ("L12",300,322),("coil 2",323,461),("tail",462,623)]
print(f"\n{'region':<10}{'len':>5}{'mean pLDDT':>12}{'% >70':>8}{'% <50':>8}")
for nm,a,b in regions:
    m=(res>=a)&(res<=b); s=v[m]
    print(f"{nm:<10}{b-a+1:>5}{s.mean():>12.1f}{100*(s>70).mean():>8.1f}{100*(s<50).mean():>8.1f}")

rodm=(res>=153)&(res<=465)
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
u,p=mannwhitneyu(v[rodm], v[~rodm], alternative="greater")
print(f"\nrod {v[rodm].mean():.1f} vs head+tail {v[~rodm].mean():.1f} pLDDT, "
      f"difference {v[rodm].mean()-v[~rodm].mean():.1f}, Mann-Whitney p = {p:.2e}")
print(f"head+tail below 50 (disordered): {100*(v[~rodm]<50).mean():.1f}%")
print(f"rod above 70: {100*(v[rodm]>70).mean():.1f}%")
him=(res>=153)&(res<=172); htm=(res>=440)&(res<=461)
print(f"helix initiation motif mean pLDDT {v[him].mean():.1f}; helix termination motif {v[htm].mean():.1f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.4))
ax.plot(res, v, lw=1.0, color="#333333")
for nm,a,b,c in [("head",1,152,"#e8e8e8"),("coil 1A",153,188,"#b03030"),("L1",189,207,"#f6f6f6"),
                 ("coil 1B",208,299,"#8aa9c9"),("L12",300,322,"#f6f6f6"),("coil 2",323,461,"#2f6f4e"),
                 ("tail",462,623,"#e8e8e8")]:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=0.45,zorder=0)
    if b-a>18: ax.text((a+b)/2, 103, nm, ha="center", fontsize=8.5)
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",color="k",lw=0.8); ax.axhline(50,ls=":",color="k",lw=0.8)
ax.text(628,71,"70",fontsize=8); ax.text(628,51,"50",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,640); ax.set_ylim(0,110)
ax.set_xlabel("residue position"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.set_title("AlphaFold confidence for KRT9: a single confident helical rod flanked by disordered glycine-rich ends")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
